title: smime-tree missing path dep on mime-tree in Cargo.toml
description: smime-tree/Cargo.toml has 'mime-tree = { version = "0.2.0" }' with no path spec. All other intra-workspace deps (yencoding-multi→yencoding, mime-tree→uuencoding) use path. Missing path means smime-tree dev builds may silently resolve to published crate instead of local changes. Fix: add path = '../mime-tree'.
